title: Moderation queue in Administration: approve, hide, ban
description:
As a moderator, I want a queue of submissions, comments and reports, so that I can approve, hide or ban quickly.

```gherkin
Feature: Moderation queue
  Scenario: Review an item
    Given an item awaiting review
    When the moderator chooses "Approve"
    Then the item is marked approved and leaves the queue

  Scenario: Hide
    When the moderator chooses "Hide"
    Then the item disappears from public pages and JSON
    And the action is recorded with the moderator and reason

  Scenario: Ban
    When the moderator bans a reader
    Then that reader's new content is rejected
    And the reader's existing content is hidden or kept per the chosen option

  Scenario: Permissions
    Then only moderator roles can see the queue
```
Lives in Administration; follows the existing staff-role model.
